stem: Torrance Outfitters has one private subnet with steady, low, predictable outbound traffic, wants the lowest total monthly egress bill, and its two-person ops team has agreed to take on the day-to-day upkeep of a self-run device to get there.

choices.text: Deploy a NAT gateway in the subnet's Availability Zone
Deploy a NAT gateway in every Availability Zone the VPC uses
Route egress through a Gateway Load Balancer appliance fleet sized for traffic inspection, not internet access
Launch a right-sized EC2 NAT instance and manage its patching

rationale: For steady, low, predictable traffic where the team is willing to manage the device, a right-sized NAT instance's EC2 cost can undercut a NAT gateway's fixed hourly charge. A single NAT gateway or one per Availability Zone keeps its hourly charge regardless of how little data it processes, which does not minimize the bill for this small workload. A Gateway Load Balancer appliance fleet is built for traffic inspection, not for providing or pricing internet egress.
